title: FILTER verse embeddings: unsloth/DeepSeek-R1-BF16 translations, word analyses and paper data
description:
unsloth/DeepSeek-R1-BF16 verse translations and word analyses, the cleaned paper input (4,311,544 rows; 291,227 poems), and supporting splits, retrieval pairs, tokenizers and corpus metadata. The original training-order word-supervision table is unavailable; see the reproduction instructions.
